info.title: Catch me! API
info.description: API generated from the request and response structs of the Go controllers.

servers.description: Production server behind TLS; clients configure their own base URL

post.summary: Create a square playground with adjustable grid size, cell size, and reveal interval

requestBody.description: All fields required and non-null: latitude, longitude, cellSizeMeters (100-5000 in steps of 100), gridSize (3-12 cells per side), revealIntervalMinutes (1-60); no date-line crossings

201.description: Game saved, with one join code per team

400.description: Invalid JSON, coordinates, or cell size

422.description: No landmark found at the edges of the playground

get.summary: Get the public result of an ended game, including player tracks, by its full game ID

200.description: Game times and duration, playground, route (start and stop), player names, runner outcomes/times, hunter teams, and each runner's and hunter's real track from start to end (thinned to 5 seconds) in join order, plus the whole event timeline oldest first; no joker results, reveals, sketches, join codes, or tokens; no authentication required

400.description: Invalid game ID; expected 32 lowercase hexadecimal characters, not a join code

404.description: Game not found, not ended, or already deleted (7 days after its end)

delete.summary: Leave the game before it starts

204.description: Left the game; the token is no longer valid

post.summary: Permanently mark yourself caught (runners, while running, no proximity check)

200.description: runner.status is caught with runner.endedAt and optional runner.caughtPosition; retries preserve the original time and position, including after game end. Everyone sees the catch immediately; further positions and joker uses are rejected. The last active runner ends the game atomically, returning status ended and endedAt

409.description: Not a runner, already finished, or game not running

post.summary: Finish at the route's stop (runners, while running)

200.description: runner.status is finished with runner.endedAt; retries preserve the original server time, including after game end. Requires a stored report within 50 m and at most 30 seconds old, unless the development start/finish override is enabled. No finish coordinates are exposed; further position reports and jokers are rejected. The last active runner ends the game atomically, returning status ended and endedAt

409.description: Not a runner, caught, game not running, or missing, stale, or distant position

get.summary: Get the game state for the authenticated player

200.description: Current game state, including status ended and endedAt once every runner is caught or finished; each runner has runner.status (active/caught/finished), runner.endedAt only after completion, and runner.caughtPosition only for retained catch reports. Hunters have no runner object

put.summary: Join or create a hunter team

requestBody.description: Team name (1-20 characters); an existing team with this name (ignoring case) is joined, otherwise a new team is created

409.description: Not a hunter, ready, or game started

requestBody.description: The joker to use, picked by kind, with exactly the fields that joker needs; while the game runs, fakePosition is once per runner, other runner jokers once for all runners together, and hunter jokers once per hunter team

200.description: Updated game state, with what the joker showed

400.description: Invalid JSON, unknown joker, missing or unexpected fields, or a point outside the playground

409.description: Caught runner, not a joker of the player's team, hunter without a team, game not running, joker already used, the runner's last reveal joker has not acted yet, or a compass without the hunter's position

put.summary: Report the authenticated player's current position

requestBody.description: Current coordinates and accuracy radius; the server records its own time

409.description: Game ended, or a caught or finished runner cannot report positions

put.summary: Set the authenticated player's ready state

requestBody.description: Ready state; the game starts 10 seconds after all players are ready and both teams have players

400.description: Invalid JSON or missing ready value

409.description: Game has already started, or the runner is not at the route's start

post.summary: Regenerate the game's route (runners, 2 times per game, while no runner is ready)

200.description: Updated game state with the new route

409.description: Not a runner, a runner is ready, no changes left, game started, or no other route available

post.summary: Draw a line on the hunter team's map

requestBody.description: 2-500 points of a freehand line; only the hunter's own team sees it

200.description: Updated game state with the team's sketches

400.description: Invalid JSON, coordinates, or number of points

409.description: Not a hunter in a team, game not running, or the team's sketch limit reached

200.description: Updated game state without the team's sketches

409.description: Not a hunter in a team, or game not running

get.summary: Get the game's event timeline (spectators only)

200.description: Game start, joker uses (joker kind with hunter team or runner), catches, finishes, and game end up to serverTime, oldest first. No coordinates, cells, or joker results. Empty before the start

409.description: Not a spectator: active runners and hunters get no timeline

post.summary: Join before game start with a runner, hunter or spectator code

requestBody.description: Join code (6 digits) and display name (1-20 characters, unique per game)

201.description: Joined; keep the player token secret

400.description: Invalid JSON, join code, or name

404.description: No game with this join code

409.description: Game started, full, or name taken

examples: cell size must be 100 to 5000 meters in steps of 100 meters

PlayerToken.description: "Bearer " followed by the playerToken returned when joining a game.
PlayerToken.name: Authorization
